name: Landfall
description: Lantern section's transport came down in the fields short of Ashgate with Dr Vey's data on board. Pull the flight recorder from the wreck and outrun the fire up the high street to the last helicopter out.
briefing: Three weeks ago Halden Agritech sprayed a blight called BRIAR on the fields round Ashgate to kill crop pests. The barley went to the food depot, the food went to the town, and the town stopped being a town.
The army has drawn a line round it: the Rotline. You are Lantern section, and your transport just fell out of the sky inside it. Kestrel got out. The flight crew did not.

The flight recorder holds the only copy of Dr Vey's field data: what BRIAR is, and maybe how to stop it. Get it, outrun the burning fields up the high street, get through the checkpoint and the square to the hospital car park. The last bird out of Ashgate lifts in twelve minutes.
debrief: Recorder's aboard and so are you. Dr Vey is going to want to meet the people who carried her life's work through a burning town.

objectives.label: Grab the flight recorder

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Lantern, this is Okafor. You are inside the Rotline with no ride. The recorder is in what is left of the cockpit. Get it and get moving before they smell the fuel.
radio.done: Recorder secured. The farm road gate is open: up the high street.

objectives.label: Outrun the fire up the high street

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren here, I'm on the water tower. The fuel from your wreck just went up and the fields are burning behind you, coming up the high street. Run for the army checkpoint and don't stop!
radio.done: You're clear of it. Checkpoint ahead. Its gate motor is dead.

objectives.label: Restart the gate generator

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: The gate runs off its own generator on the pavement. Start it and keep them off it while it spins up.
radio.done: Generator's running. The gate is taking it.

objectives.label: Hold the checkpoint while the gate opens

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Every one of them heard that motor. Hold the checkpoint!
radio.done: Gate's open. The square is worse.

objectives.label: Pick up the sample cases in the square

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: This is Dr Vey, on Kestrel's set. An army truck went over in the square with my sample cases: the only BRIAR cultures outside Halden. I need four of them. Mind the growths round the fountain, they're nests.
radio.done: Four cases. That's enough to work with. Something big is coming out of the town hall.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: That's a Brute. It was the butcher, I think. Stay off its line and keep shooting.
radio.done: It's down. The car park gate is open.

objectives.label: Hold the pad until the bird lands

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel here, I got a new bird and I am not crashing this one. Forty seconds: keep that pad clear.

objectives.label: Get on the bird

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Wheels down! Lantern, everybody on, now!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 150
Optional: burn the nests in the square

notes.title: Cotter's farm diary
notes.text: Halden men back with the sprayers again, white suits, said the barley would come up clean of weevil for ten years. It came up clean all right. The cows won't go near the north field and the dog dug something up out of it that was still moving. Sold the crop to the depot Tuesday. Good price.

notes.title: Checkpoint log, day 6
notes.text: Orders changed again. Nobody leaves without a Halden pass. Nobody has a Halden pass. A woman brought her boy to the gate, said he was only feverish. Sergeant told me to stop counting the ones we turn back. I have stopped counting. I have not stopped hearing them.

notes.title: A letter from the bank
notes.text: Elaine. The army took the vault keys on Monday and filled it with Halden's boxes: sample cases, they said, too precious to move. Then they bricked the door up and left. I have been sleeping above them. Something in there scratches at night. If the bird comes, take it. Don't wait for me.

name: Rail Yard
description: The last train east is waiting on Ashgate's freight yard, and the points are locked. Find the switch keys, take the stacks lane by lane, throw the points and keep the motor running while four hundred people cross.
briefing: Four hundred people are sitting in a train on the far side of Ashgate's freight yard, engine running, going nowhere: the points are locked and the signalman is dead.
His switch keys are in the stationmaster's office. The yard is three sections behind gates: the platform, the container stacks, the signal yard. Each gate locks behind you.
Throw the points from the signal box, then keep the points motor alive while the train crawls over it. If it stalls on the junction, nobody on it gets out. The fog is thick: listen for them.
debrief: The last train is over the junction and out of the Rotline. Four hundred and twelve people. Hollis says she'll name her next engine after you.

objectives.label: Find the switch keys

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: Lantern, this is Hollis, driving the train you can't see in this soup. Stationmaster kept the switch keys in his office, west side of the platform. Bring them to the yard gate.
radio.done: Keys on the gate. It's open: into the stacks.

objectives.label: Take the three lanes through the stacks

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: Hollis. The train needs three clear lanes through the stacks to see the signals: west, middle and east. Stand in each till my lamp man calls it clear. Nests in there, burn them if you like.
radio.done: All three lanes clear. The north gate runs off the crane.

objectives.label: Start the crane generator

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: The crane's generator works the north gate. Start it and keep them off it while it runs up. The whole yard is going to hear it.
radio.done: Gate's up. The signal box is on the east side of the signal yard.

objectives.label: Throw the points in the signal box

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: Signal box, east side. Get the door open and throw the points from the panel. Then don't go far.
radio.done: Points thrown. I'm rolling. The points motor has to hold the blades while I cross: keep them off it!

objectives.label: Keep the points motor running while the train crosses

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: Sixty seconds over the junction. If that motor stops, my front bogie goes off the rails with four hundred people behind it!
radio.done: Over! Clear of the junction. The road gate is open.

objectives.label: Get on the trucks

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor here. Trucks are on the convoy road between the warehouses. Everyone on.

objectives.label: Optional: put down 150
Optional: burn the nests in the stacks

notes.title: Consignment ledger
notes.text: Halden Agritech, 40 crates "seed stock", to Ashgate Food Depot, priority, no inspection by order of the Ministry. Halden Agritech, 12 crates, return to Harrow, sealed, ARMED ESCORT. Halden Agritech, 1 tanker, contents not declared. I asked what was in the tanker. The escort asked how my wife was.

notes.title: Note on the signal panel
notes.text: If you are reading this I did not make it back from the yard. Points are locked with the keys, not the panel, so the trains can't be turned back to the city. Halden's idea. Keys are with Pell. Whatever you do, get the people out on the east line. Do not let them send the train to Harrow.

notes.title: Scratched into the lamp room wall
notes.text: They said the rot is in the barley. Then why is it in the rats. Then why is it in the water. Then why is it in me. Day 4 in here. Bricked myself in with the lamps. They light up when the dead walk past.

name: Blackout
description: Ashgate's power plant has gone dark, and with it the wards in Harrow where Dr Vey's first patients are holding on. Get the plant running again, one generator and one floodlight at a time.
briefing: Dr Vey has eleven patients in Harrow General who caught BRIAR and did not turn: the first ones her serum kept alive. They are on machines. The machines run off Ashgate's power plant, and the plant has gone dark.
There are no lights inside. Use your weapon lights. Each generator you restart brings floodlights back on: the yard gets brighter as you work, and so does what is hunting you in it.

Find diesel for the backup generator, restart the three generators, keep the transformer standing while it charges, reroute the grid from the control room and get out past the cooling towers. Thirteen minutes on the hospital's batteries.
debrief: Harrow General's wards just came back on. Eleven patients, eleven heartbeats. Dr Vey cried on the radio. Don't tell her I told you.

objectives.label: Get to the plant fence

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: Bielak, shift engineer, the last one. I'm on the radio from the turbine hall roof. Plant's dead and it's dark as a coal hole in there. Get to the fence.

objectives.label: Find diesel for the backup generator

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: The fence gate runs off a backup generator by the car park, and some fool drained it for the night shift's cars. There's diesel lying about the guardhouses and the car park: four cans will do.
radio.done: That's enough diesel. Fill her up.

objectives.label: Start the backup generator

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: Backup generator, by the fence. Start it and hold them off while it runs up.
radio.done: Gate's open. Lights are on at the fence. Into the yard.

objectives.label: Restart the three generators

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: Three generators in the transformer yard: west, east, north. Every one you start lights a floodlight and wakes a turret. Two nests in the yard corners: burn them if you get the chance.
radio.done: All three running. Look at that: you can see the yard.

objectives.label: Keep the transformer running

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: Transformer charges for sixty seconds and it hums like a dinner bell. Everything in the yard is coming for it!
radio.done: Transformer's live. The control building is open.

objectives.label: Reroute the grid from the control room

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: Control room, east of the turbine hall. Get the door open and work the panel. I'll talk you through it.
radio.done: Grid rerouted. Harrow's getting power. Something just knocked over a turbine.

objectives.label: Out past the cooling towers before the turbines burn

radio.speaker: Bielak
radio.start: Grid's rerouted but the turbines are running away with it. The hall's on fire and it's coming your way. Out past the cooling towers, go!

objectives.label: Optional: thin them out
Optional: burn the nests in the yard

notes.title: Shift log, night 9
notes.text: Cooling water intake clogged again. Pulled it up: not weed. White threads, warm to the touch, growing back as you cut them. Halden's contract says the plant feeds their Harrow site first, always, even over the hospital. Day shift didn't come in. Night shift is me.

notes.title: Memo pinned in the control room
notes.text: PRIORITY SUPPLY. In any shortfall, load shedding is to follow the Halden schedule: Halden Harrow site, Ministry, Harrow General, residential. This instruction supersedes local emergency procedure. Questions to Minister Marlowe's office.

notes.title: Under the guard's chair
notes.text: Bricked the door myself. Got biscuits, water, the radio. Heard the army say they're drawing a line round the whole district and calling it the Rotline. Funny name for a cemetery. If the lights come on again, someone came for us. Leave the biscuits.

name: Holdouts
description: Elm Close barricaded itself in when Ashgate fell, and somewhere in it is Mila Pryce, nine, bitten three weeks ago and still herself. Raise the families, burn the nests in their gardens, and walk everyone to the school.

objectives.label: Clear the main road

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Lantern, Okafor. The main road outside Elm Close is crawling. Clear it and the residents will roll their gate back.
radio.done: Gate's opening. Someone in there still has a winch.

objectives.label: Raise the families on the residents' radio

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Their radio is in the first house on the left. Get on it and find out where the families are.
radio.done: Got them. The Pryces on the north side, the Abaras on the south. There are nests in their back gardens: that's why they stopped answering.

objectives.label: Walk the families to the far barricade

radio.speaker: Mila
radio.start: Are you the soldiers? Mum says to stay behind you. The tall man in the garden is still there. He doesn't move but he watches.
radio.done: We're at the gate. Mum's crying but the good kind.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute in the schoolyard

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Gate's open, and the tall man from her drawing is a Brute, standing in the schoolyard by the minibus. It has to go.
radio.done: It's down. Minibus is clear.

objectives.label: Walk the minibus out through the park

radio.speaker: Hollis
radio.start: Hollis again, I'm driving the minibus. Families are aboard. I go at walking pace through the park and only while you're round me: they claw at it, I slow down. Keep them off my bonnet!

objectives.label: Optional: crack the gun shop's safe
Optional: burn the nests in the back gardens

briefing: Elm Close held: the residents rolled containers across both ends of the street and waited. Two families are still in there. Their radio went quiet this morning.
One of them has a girl called Mila Pryce. She was bitten in the school playground three weeks ago, and she never turned. Dr Vey says Mila's blood may be the whole cure. Okafor says bring everyone.

Clear the main road so the residents open their gate, raise them on their radio, walk both families through the far barricade to the school, then walk the minibus out through the park beside it: it is slow, it is loud, and every dead thing in the Close will want it. The roads close in fifteen minutes.
debrief: Minibus is rolling with both families on it. Mila asked if the soldiers are the ones from her drawing. Elm Close held out. So did you.

notes.title: Residents' meeting, minutes
notes.text: Agreed: containers across both ends (Mr Okoye's crane). Agreed: no one leaves alone. Agreed: Mila Pryce stays with us whatever the army says about the bitten. Not agreed: what to do about the Hendersons' house. Mr Henderson bricked his own front door up on Thursday and has not answered since.

notes.title: A child's drawing
notes.text: A house, a sun, Mum, Dad, me. The tall man in the garden. He doesn't come in. Soldiers coming down the road with lights on their guns. (In crayon, underneath:) They will come. Mrs Fry said.

notes.title: Note on the kitchen table
notes.text: I saw what the bitten do. I am not going to do it in front of anyone. Ammunition in the cupboard, for whoever opens this house. Tell the Pryces I'm sorry I said what I said about their girl. She's braver than the lot of us.

name: Breakout
description: The last column out of Ashgate is loading at the army's motor pool with Mila, Dr Vey and every survivor on board. Hold the yard, take back the loading bays, then walk the last truck out of the north gate.

objectives.label: Hold the centre

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: Briggs, motor pool. Column's loading. Hold the square in the middle and draw them onto you, not onto my trucks.
radio.done: Half loaded. They're coming over the fences now.

objectives.label: Start the generators for the turrets

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: Generators west and east, by the sheds and the workshop. Get them running and the turrets wake up.
radio.done: Turrets are up. Here comes the next lot.

objectives.label: Take the loading bays back

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: They're into the loading bays: the sheds, the workshop and the fuel stores by the barracks. Take each one back and stand in it till my lads can load. Screamers in this lot: kill them first!
radio.done: Bays are ours. Last truck's nearly loaded.

objectives.label: Put down the Brutes

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Two Brutes through the south fence, heading for the trucks!
radio.done: Both down. I did not think that was possible. North gate's open!

objectives.label: Walk the last truck out of the north gate

radio.speaker: Sgt Briggs
radio.start: Last truck's the one with Mila and the doctor on it, and it's got a flat. It rolls while you walk with it and it crawls when they climb on it. Get it through the north gate!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 250

briefing: This is the end of Ashgate. Every survivor the Rotline found is in the motor pool, loading onto trucks: the train people, the Elm Close families, Dr Vey and her data, Mila Pryce.
The engines are pulling in everything for miles. Hold the square in the middle of the yard while they load. Two generators can wake the turrets. Brutes have been seen at the south fence.
The last truck goes out with you walking beside it, through the north gate, and the Rotline pulls back to Harrow. Fourteen minutes. After that, the order is to burn the town.
debrief: Column's clear, every truck, and the motor pool is theirs now. Ashgate is burning behind you. The Rotline is Harrow's problem now. So are you.

notes.title: Requisition, stamped DENIED
notes.text: Request: 400 litres diesel, 12 trucks, medical kit for 300 civilians. Denied: fuel and vehicles are reserved for Halden Agritech evacuation (Ministry order 14). Briggs' note in the margin: we are taking them anyway. Court-martial me in Harrow.

notes.title: An unsent letter
notes.text: Mum. They're calling it the Rotline like it's a thing on a map. It's us. It's twenty of us and some fences. A little girl came in today that got bitten and she's fine, she's eating crisps. The doctor lady looked at her like she was Christmas.

notes.title: Orders, in the quartermaster's bunker
notes.text: In the event the Rotline cannot be held at Ashgate, all Halden Agritech material is to be destroyed in place and the town denied to the infection by fire. Civilian evacuation is not to delay this order. Signed, E. Marlowe.

name: Airlift
description: Kestrel brought Mila's blood samples to Harrow airfield and both ramps jammed open on landing. Hold the cargo bay while the crew fixes it, and nobody touches the cold box.
briefing: Harrow, the city past the Rotline. Kestrel's transport put down on the airfield with a cold box full of Mila Pryce's blood, bound for Dr Vey's lab. Both ramps jammed open on landing.

Every dead thing for miles heard it land. Hold the cargo bay while the crew works, then bring in the medical supplies the drop scattered across the apron. The jumpseat room opens once the ramps are up.
The hydraulics run off the ground power unit on the apron. Something big is coming across the runway. It doesn't get near the plane.
debrief: Wheels up with the samples aboard. Dr Vey has her blood. She says give her a week. She says it like a prayer.

objectives.label: Hold the cargo bay

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. Both ramps are jammed open and I have a cold box that is worth more than this airfield. Hold the bay while my crew gets to work!
radio.done: First ramp's moving. Need ground power for the rest.

objectives.label: Bring in the medical supplies off the apron

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Dr Vey, on the line from Harrow General. The supply drop came down all over the apron when the chutes failed: serum kit, saline, cold packs. Bring in five crates or my patients go without.
radio.done: Five crates aboard. Thank you.

objectives.label: Start the power unit on the apron

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: The ground power unit is on the apron off the tail. Get it running and the ramp turrets wake up.
radio.done: Power's on. The ramps are taking it.

objectives.label: Keep the ramp hydraulics running

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Hydraulics are between the ramps and they're going for them. Sixty seconds!
radio.done: Ramps are up. Jumpseat room's open, there's a med kit in there.

objectives.label: Clear the apron for take-off

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: Wren, in the tower. Brute crossing the apron, right where Kestrel needs to roll. Put it down!
radio.done: Apron's clear.

objectives.label: Everyone aboard

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Engines are spinning up. Nose up in forty: get in the bay!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200

notes.title: Tower log
notes.text: All civilian traffic suspended. Halden Agritech charter cleared to land and depart at any time, no manifest. Third Halden flight today. Something in the cargo hold of the second one was banging. Ground crew refused to unload it. Bricked ourselves in on the ground floor.

notes.title: Grease pencil on the hangar door
notes.text: Ramp hydraulics on the transports are rubbish, always were. If you're stuck: ground power unit first, then the pumps, then pray. Gone home to my kids. If I have a home.

notes.title: A boarding card
notes.text: Halden Agritech staff evacuation, flight H-3, Gate 2. On the back, in pen: they took the scientists and left the cleaners. I cleaned the lab. I know what was in it.

name: Hive
description: The supermarket on Harrow's ring road took the last delivery from Ashgate's food depot. Now it breathes. Burn its pods, sample its growths and burn the thing in the loading yard before it seeds the city.
briefing: The supermarket on Harrow's ring road took the last lorry of barley flour out of Ashgate's food depot. It went quiet a week ago. Now it breathes.
Dr Vey calls it a hive: the rot has learned to build. Pods in the car park, nests in the aisles, and in the loading yard an egg the size of a van, with a brood round it.
Dr Vey wants samples from the aisles before it all burns. Then burn the brood: if the big one hatches in the city centre, Harrow goes the way of Ashgate.
debrief: The hive is ash and the ring road is quiet. Dr Vey has her samples and wants one of whatever hatched. Okafor said no. Okafor said it twice.

objectives.label: Burn the pods in the car park

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Pods all over the car park. Burn them, then we'll get the front doors open.
radio.done: Car park's clear. The doors are giving way.

objectives.label: Into the supermarket

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Get inside before the doors fall on you.

objectives.label: Take samples off the growths in the aisles

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Dr Vey. Before you burn anything: the growths in the aisles are the rot learning to build, and I need to know how. Cut me four samples. The nests will fight you for them.
radio.done: Four samples. The loading doors are open.

objectives.label: Burn the brood round the egg

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Three smaller eggs round the big one. The brood feeds it. Burn them first.
radio.done: Brood's gone. It's starving. It's coming out early!

objectives.label: Kill what hatches

radio.speaker: Wren
radio.start: It's out! Put it down!
radio.done: It's dead. Van's on its way.

objectives.label: Out of the yard before the fire takes it

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. The fire you lit in the aisles is through the roof and coming across the yard from the east. Van's at the far west corner. Run!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200
Optional: burn the nests among the aisles

notes.title: Delivery note
notes.text: Barley flour, 2 pallets. Supplier: Halden Agritech trial fields. Price: nil (promotional). Note from the driver: they paid me double to bring it and not ask. Store manager signed for it. I didn't look back.

notes.title: An email, printed
notes.text: To head office. Staff are reporting a smell from the loading yard, sweet, like bread. Two of the night crew have not come back from the cold store. Please advise. (Handwritten:) No reply. Sealing the cold store. God help me.

notes.title: In the cold store
notes.text: Pete and me. Doors won't open from in here. Something is growing on the ceiling and it's warm. It's not cold in here any more. It's never cold any more.

name: Lifeline
description: Harrow General is losing power again, and on its top ward Dr Vey's eleven patients are in remission. The building is dark. Clear the atrium and restore the switch rooms one corridor at a time.
briefing: Harrow General: the hospital Blackout kept alive. Its doors still keep the dead out, but the Halden supply contract has cut its power again, and the backup batteries won't last.

It is dark inside. Your weapon lights are all you have until the switches are in. Four switch rooms, each at the end of its own corridor off the atrium; the corridors open one at a time as you work through the wards: the files in the north, the nurses' stations in the east.
The last team in didn't make it past the atrium. Their kit is still on the floor. Somewhere in this building is the file on patient zero.
debrief: Lights are on in Harrow General and every patient made it. In the patient zero file is one word Dr Vey had never seen: LANTERN. Marlowe's project, not hers.

objectives.label: Clear the atrium

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Dr Vey, on the top ward. They're coming out of the walls in the atrium. Clear it and the first corridor opens. Keep your lights on.
radio.done: Corridor Alpha's open, north side.

objectives.label: Throw switch Alpha

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Alpha's at the far end, past the ward. Throw it and come back.
radio.done: Alpha's in. The north wing has light.

objectives.label: Collect the BRIAR patients' files from the wards

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: While you're in the north wards: every BRIAR patient they ever admitted has a paper file, and Halden took the computers. Find me four. Something in them made Marlowe nervous.
radio.done: Four files. Bravo's open, east side.

objectives.label: Throw switch Bravo

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Bravo's room is up the corridor and round the corner.
radio.done: Two in. They're into the east wing.

objectives.label: Hold the nurses' stations

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: The nurses' stations on the east wing run the ward doors. Stand at each till its panel resets, and kill the screamers first. Charlie opens after, south side.
radio.done: Charlie's open.

objectives.label: Throw switch Charlie

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Charlie's down the long corridor, the far west room.
radio.done: Three in. One to go.

objectives.label: Clear the atrium one more time

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Last lot before Delta. North-east door.
radio.done: Delta's open.

objectives.label: Throw switch Delta

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Delta's at the end of the north-east corridor.
radio.done: Power's back! Every light in the building... oh no. Two of them just walked into the atrium.

objectives.label: Put down the Brutes in the atrium

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: Two Brutes in the atrium! Keep them off the wards!
radio.done: Both down. Ambulance bay, now.

objectives.label: Out through the ambulance bay

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Ambulance bay, everyone. Forty-five seconds.

objectives.label: Optional: put down 250

notes.title: Night nurse's notes
notes.text: Bed 4 sat up and asked for tea. Bed 4 has had BRIAR for nineteen days. Dr Vey's serum, third dose. The lesions are drying. I have been nursing for thirty years and I sat down in the corridor and laughed.

notes.title: Patient file, sealed
notes.text: Patient zero. Arthur Penn, 61, gardener, Harrow Botanical Gardens. Admitted with lesions after handling a test crop in the Glasshouse. Transferred to Halden custody, project LANTERN, by order of Minister Marlowe. Not to be discussed with Dr Vey.

notes.title: A dog-eared notebook
notes.text: Beacon section, atrium. Lights out at 0200. Something in the walls. If you're the next team: they come from the ducts, not the doors. Keep your backs to the pillars. Tell my sister I said the thing I never said.

name: The Minister
description: Minister Edwin Marlowe signed BRIAR's field trials a year early, and he holds the codes to Halden's sealed lab under the city. He is locked in his safe room. Get him out alive. Answers can come later.
briefing: Edwin Marlowe, Minister for Reconstruction, approved BRIAR's field trials a year ahead of Dr Vey's safety tests and ran something called LANTERN behind her back. He is also the only man alive with the codes to Halden's sealed lab under the metro.
He locked himself in the safe room of his house on the hill when the dead came up the drive. The house is a maze of rooms; the gardens round it are worse.

Find his papers in the halls, override the safe room lock from the kitchen, walk him to the helipad on the lawn and light the pad. The garden generator wakes the pad's turrets. Nine minutes before the chopper turns back.
debrief: Marlowe is aboard and he gave up the codes before the skids left the grass. He didn't say sorry. Okafor didn't ask him to.

objectives.label: Get inside the house

radio.speaker: Marlowe
radio.start: Hello? Is someone out there? They're in the house. I can hear them in the halls. I am a minister of the crown, I demand...

objectives.label: Find the minister's papers before they burn

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. Ignore him. His study fire's been lit and his staff were burning paper when the dead came in. Whatever's left about LANTERN is lying round the halls: pick up four of them before you open that safe room.
radio.done: That's enough to hang him. Now get him.

objectives.label: Override the safe room lock

radio.speaker: Marlowe
radio.start: The override is in the kitchen, by the door. Please hurry. Please.
radio.done: It's open! Get me out of here!

objectives.label: Walk the minister to the helipad

radio.speaker: Marlowe
radio.start: Stay close to me. You don't understand, LANTERN was meant to save people. It was meant to...
radio.done: Is that the chopper? Tell me that's the chopper.

objectives.label: Light the four corners of the pad

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. I can't see the pad in this. The landing lights are on posts at each corner: stand at each one till it comes on!
radio.done: I see four lights. Coming round.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute on the lawn

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: I'm not setting down with that thing on the lawn!
radio.done: Lawn's clear. Coming in.

objectives.label: Everyone on the chopper

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: On the skids. Thirty seconds!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200

notes.title: A letter on the study desk
notes.text: Sana is right that BRIAR is not ready. She is wrong that it matters. The fields were sprayed; the Treasury has its harvest figures. LANTERN will contain any spread: a serum we can make ourselves, without her. If it fails, Ashgate is small. Ashgate can be burned.

notes.title: Diary, last page
notes.text: Day 7 in the safe room. LANTERN did not work. Penn turned in the lab and they could not stop him. The child, the Pryce child, is the answer. Sana has her. Sana has always had the answer. I gave the codes to no one. I will give them to whoever opens this door.

notes.title: In the gardener's bothy
notes.text: Mr Penn from the Glasshouse came here last spring with cuttings from the trial crop, said the minister wanted them in the rose beds. Roses died. Then the hedges. I bricked myself in when Mr Penn came back. He was walking wrong.

name: Cure
description: Dr Vey has made it: a serum from Mila Pryce's blood, in Halden's sealed lab at the end of the metro. Take Marlowe's codes down through the dark station and carry the cure up before the bombers reach Harrow.
briefing: This is it. Dr Vey went down to Halden's sealed lab under the metro with Marlowe's codes and Mila's blood, and twelve hours later sent one message: it works. Then the lab went silent.
The station has no power. Your weapon lights are all you have, past the ticket hall and down through a stopped train to the tunnel and the blast door. Six labs past it: the index terminal says which.
The government has given up on Harrow. Bombers are over the city in eleven minutes. Carry the cure to the pad on the roof yard. Whatever happens after, it is out.
debrief: The cure is on the bird, and so is Dr Vey, who was in lab four with the door barred, holding it. Mila is waiting at the airfield. Behind you, Harrow lights up white. The Rotline is broken. So is the rot.

objectives.label: Take both stairheads at the entrance

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Kestrel. Dropping you by the stadium. Two stairheads down into the station: take both and hold them till the rest of the street gives up.
radio.done: Station doors are open. No going back up after this.

objectives.label: Open the platform gates from the ticket office

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: Okafor. The platform gates are run from the ticket office, west side of the hall. It's dark down there. Lights on.
radio.done: Gates are up. Down you go.

objectives.label: Through the train ahead of the gas

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: ...gas... the dead train's tank is leaking, it's spreading up the platform behind you. Through the carriages and out the far end, quick!
radio.done: You're through and it's settling. Don't go back.

objectives.label: Power the blast door

radio.speaker: Major Okafor
radio.start: The tunnel's generator runs the blast door. Start it and hold while it runs up.
radio.done: Blast door's open. Labs ahead.

objectives.label: Find which lab Dr Vey is in

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: ...Lantern? Is that you? It's Vey. I'm in a lab, I don't know which, the index terminal by the door will say. Please hurry.
radio.done: Lab four, east side. Its door is open now.

objectives.label: Carry the cure to the pad

radio.speaker: Dr Vey
radio.start: The case on the bench. It's all of it. Every dose. Don't drop it, I don't have Mila's blood for another batch.
radio.done: Cure's on the pad.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute on the pad

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: There's something huge on the roof yard, I can't land! Is that... that's Penn. Patient zero.
radio.done: It's down. He's down. Coming in.

objectives.label: Everyone on the bird

radio.speaker: Kestrel
radio.start: Forty-five seconds, then the bombers are over the city!

objectives.label: Optional: put down 200
Optional: burn the nest in the dead train

notes.title: Station announcement script
notes.text: This station is closed by order of the Ministry. Halden Agritech personnel only beyond this point. Passengers are asked to make their way to the surface. (Scrawled across it:) THERE IS NO SURFACE LEFT

notes.title: Staff room noticeboard
notes.text: Lights out at 2300 every night now. Halden says the trains carry "seed stock" to the lab at the end of the line. We've stopped asking. Kettle's broken. Somebody bricked the door from the outside. Not funny, Gary.

notes.title: Lab journal, last entry
notes.text: Batch complete. Mila's antibodies bind BRIAR's coat protein and the whole thing falls apart, like pulling one thread out of a jumper. I made this. I unmade it. If you are reading this and I am not here, take the case. Tell Mila she saved everyone. Tell her she can have the crisps.

briefing: The food depot is boiling over. Three minutes: kill everything that moves.
